newsitem.title: FRANCE: France ups 96 rapeseed crop estimate to 2.9 mln T.
newsitem.headline: France ups 96 rapeseed crop estimate to 2.9 mln T.

text.p: The French farm ministry said on Friday it was revising upwards its estimate for the 1996 rapeseed harvest to 2.9 million tonnes from a previous target of 2.7 million tonnes and from 2.8 million tonnes produced last year, mostly due to higher yields.
In its September report, the ministry said the estimate assumed an average yield of 3.31 tonnes per hectare against 3.17 tonnes forecast last month and 3.22 tonnes last year.
Area was also revised upwards to 872,000 hectares from 859,000 hectares last month and 864,000 hectares last year. --Paris newsroom +331 4221 5432
